inscient.definition:
a. Having little or no knowledge; ignorant; stupid; silly.
a. Having knowledge or insight; intelligent.

inscribable.definition:
a. Capable of being inscribed, -- used specif. (Math.) of
   solids or plane figures capable of being inscribed in other solids or
   figures.
inscribable.translation: a. 可刻的, 可雕的, 可题写的

inscribe.definition:
v. draw within a figure so as to touch in as many places as possible
v. write, engrave, or print as a lasting record
v. address, (a work of literature) in a style less formal than a dedication
inscribe.translation:
vt. 登记, 铭记于, 题写, 雕刻
[电] 书写

inscribed.definition: s. written (by handwriting, printing, engraving, or carving) on or in a surface
inscribed.translation: a. 内切的；记名的；有铭刻的

inscribes.definition:
v carve, cut, or etch into a material or surface
v register formally as a participant or member
v draw within a figure so as to touch in as many places as possible
v write, engrave, or print as a lasting record
v mark with one's signature
v convert ordinary language into code
v address, (a work of literature) in a style less formal than a dedication
inscribes.translation: v. 写, 刻( inscribe的第三人称单数 )

inscribing.definition:
v carve, cut, or etch into a material or surface
v register formally as a participant or member
v draw within a figure so as to touch in as many places as possible
v write, engrave, or print as a lasting record
v mark with one's signature
v convert ordinary language into code
v address, (a work of literature) in a style less formal than a dedication
inscribing.translation: n. 登记；买或卖股票；注册

inscription.definition:
n. letters inscribed (especially words engraved or carved) on something
n. the activity of inscribing (especially carving or engraving) letters or words
inscription.translation:
n. 题字, 碑铭
[医] 划, 药量记载

inscriptionless.translation: a. 无碑铭的,无题字的

inscriptions.definition:
n. letters inscribed (especially words engraved or carved) on something
n. a short message (as in a book or musical work or on a photograph) dedicating it to someone or something
n. the activity of inscribing (especially carving or engraving) letters or words
inscriptions.translation: n. （作者）题词( inscription的复数形式 ); 献词; 碑文; 证劵持有人的登记

inscriptive.definition: a. of or relating to an inscription
inscriptive.translation: a. 铭文的, 题铭的

inscriptively.definition: r by means of an inscription

inscroll.definition: v. t. To write on a scroll; to record.

inscrolling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Inscroll

inscrutability.definition: n. the quality of being impossible to investigate
inscrutability.translation: n. 不可预测, 不可解, 不可思议

inscrutable.translation:
a. 难以了解的, 不能预测的
[法] 不可理解的, 不可思议的, 不可测知的

inscrutableness.definition:
n. The quality or state of being inscrutable;
   inscrutability.

insculp.definition: v. t. To engrave; to carve; to sculpture.

insculptate.translation: 雕空的, 挖空了的, 具凹点的
